description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeOnLeaveDao class within the OrangeHRM project. The class is part of the Dashboard module's Data Access Object (DAO) layer and provides methods to retrieve and count employee leave records based on specific search filters. It interacts with the Leave entity and constructs SQL queries for fetching leave data, including filtering by leave status, date, and employee accessibility.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveDao
classes.description: A data access object class for retrieving employee leave data from the database, supporting filtering, pagination, and count operations.

methods.name: getEmployeeOnLeaveList
methods.description: Fetches a list of employee leave records matching the provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getLeaveListPaginator
methods.description: Creates and configures a paginator object for querying leave data based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeOnLeaveCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of employee leave records matching the filter criteria.
